mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in >60% of months with FEDFUNDS declining >0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers increased investor confidence in labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in months when UNRATE falls below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing construction (HOUST) signals robust demand growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% AND HOUST increases > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise as specified, or the increases are not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index above 105.5 indicates expanding supply capacity, which reduces production cost pressures and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in months when INDPRO exceeds 105.5 by >1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.05% during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in months when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.05%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained deflationary environment (CPIAUCSL falling below 235.0) reduces inflation risk premiums, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in months when CPIAUCSL drops below 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 5.5% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting investor sentiment quickly, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and UNRATE move as specified, or the changes are not concurrent.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of robust demand growth (GDPC1 rising) and strong industrial production (INDPRO above 105.5) creates a balanced economic environment, reducing uncertainty over the medium term and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO meet the specified conditions.
